_comment_user_name: user_name: Spoken owner name, or empty when Milo should not use one.
_comment_model: model: Ollama tag selected at startup and during warmup.
_comment_models: models: Ollama tag to notebook label mapping, keep only models already pulled.
_comment_voice: voice: Pocket TTS preset selected at startup.
_comment_voices: voices: Pocket TTS presets cached and offered by Milo.
_comment_port: port: Loopback port for the demo server.
_comment_ollama_url: ollama_url: Loopback base URL for Ollama.
_comment_whisper_url: whisper_url: Loopback base URL for whisper.cpp.
_comment_models_dir: models_dir: Pocket TTS cache and exported voice-state directory.
_comment_documents_dir: documents_dir: Notebook documents. Null uses the platform default data directory.
_comment_settings_dir: settings_dir: Notebook preferences. Null uses the platform default data directory.
_comment_memory_path: memory_path: Markdown notes file the person edits. Null uses ~/.local/state/milo/memory.md.
_comment_reminders_path: reminders_path: Retained reminders JSON path. Null uses the built-in default.
_comment_turn_log: turn_log: Local turn ledger JSONL path. Null uses the built-in default.
_comment_freshness_db: freshness_db: SQLite path for the recent-information index. Null uses the built-in default.
_comment_kiwix_url: kiwix_url: Loopback Kiwix base URL. Empty turns the offline library off.
_comment_workspace_root: workspace_root: Root holding workspace.json. Empty turns the workspace book off.
_comment_personal_book: personal_book: Personal book configuration JSON path. Empty turns the personal book off.
_comment_silence_ms: silence_ms: End-of-turn silence gate in milliseconds.
_comment_tts_threads: tts_threads: CPU thread count reserved for Pocket TTS.
